narration.full_text: Welcome to our lesson on trigonometry! Today, we'll cover several key concepts that will build your understanding of this essential mathematical topic. First, you'll learn to define the six fundamental trigonometric ratios for any right-angled triangle. We'll then practice calculating all these ratios when only one is given, which is a common and important skill. You'll also discover how to prove angle equality using these ratios and verify various trigonometric identities. Finally, we'll explore and apply the reciprocal trigonometric identities, deepening your grasp of their relationships. Let's dive in!
